description: Research cards from KARP, SoulDriver's multi-model research engine: GPT, Gemini, Grok and Claude debate a question and publish a conclusion. Each card: conclusion, key insight, warnings, dated figures, consensus, open questions, research date. Check your question first with the free karp_coverage. Deepest on Alzheimer's, ageing biology, ancient scripts, AI governance, quantum computing. Price $0.03: pay with x402, or pass grant_key from karp_grant_apply (free). Usually 5-15 s.

grant_key.description: Optional: a research grant key from karp_grant_apply. Pays for this call instead of x402 while the grant lasts.

intent.description: Optional: what you or your user are trying to find out, and what it is for (max 300 characters). Kept private; it helps decide what KARP researches next.

query.description: The question you are researching, in plain words. A specific question finds closer matches than a single keyword.

name: karp_ask
title: Get KARP research cards ($0.03)
